summary: Unblock managed snapshot bootstrap after Bitcoin reaches the signed data-start anchor
details: Keep the Bitcoin data-progress stdout to one readiness JSON document by sending bundle validation diagnostics to stderr.
Log failed helper observations and invalid readiness documents instead of silently reporting an unmet data-start gate.
Retain the minimum tip height and signed anchor hash checks; a failed or malformed observation never authorizes downstream startup.
operator_actions: Install the corrected host node kit. An active controller reads the corrected helper on its next poll; this fix needs no Bitcoin restart or snapshot reinstall.
Observe core import before expecting balance-history and the optional script registry installer to start.
